Let's sketch the graph of $y=\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x):$ 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13996467/assets/9dcc5a116c2a564547283783a7df7b1cd3a9ab3b76ac24dc2695c4cb367796d5.png)

The domain of $\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x)$ is $x\in [-1,1].$   

Now, substituting $x=\sqrt{3}/2$ directly into the limit, we have  

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \,\sqrt{3}/2}(\frac{3\pi }{2}+3\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x)) & =\frac{3\pi }{2}+3\cdot \operatorname{arccos}⁡(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}) \\  & =\frac{3\pi }{2}+3\cdot (\frac{\pi }{6}) \\  & =2\pi .\end{aligned}
$$
